BioMate

Analyze Flow Cytometry Immunophenotyping — gates FSC/SSC scatter plots and quantifies event counts across immune cell populations from flow cytometry data.

Input: Instrument blank FCS file (format and gating validation run)
Key steps:
Singlet gate on FSC-A vs FSC-H (doublet exclusion)
FSC/SSC scatter gating (lymphocyte, monocyte, granulocyte regions)
Population event counting and statistics per gate
Expected output: Gated population counts table, FSC/SSC scatter plot with gate overlays, QC report

This run uses your instrument blank to establish gating templates and validate the analysis pipeline. Once complete, attach a labelled biological sample (with surface marker panels — CD3, CD4, CD8, CD19, CD14, etc.) and re-run to quantify immune subset frequencies and absolute counts per population.
